intent: source-ci: also run on dev pushes so it can gate the ff-merge
notes: Discovered while pushing the release-and-deploy rewrite: source-ci.yml's trigger was `on: push: branches: [main]` — it only ran on main pushes, never on dev pushes. The `dev → main` flow I documented earlier this session assumed source-ci runs on dev too (that's the whole point — validate on dev, ff-merge to main when green). Without dev in the trigger list, "wait for source-ci green on dev" wasn't actually possible — no run would ever fire.
Fix: add `dev` to the push branches list. Kept `pull_request: branches: [main]` unchanged — PRs still target main (external contributors would follow the standard fork→PR→main pattern, not fork→dev).
Inline comment added explaining the intent so a future editor understands why dev is in the trigger list.
